title: These Jump Attempts Go Wrong in Shocking Ways
description: Ordinary people try bold jumps and athletic moves that spiral into total chaos. One leaps from a garage, another kicks a ball with disastrous results, a third attempts acrobatics on a bed, and the last races toward water. Each stunt builds to an unexpected disaster you won't see coming.
